answer: Each identity posts a stake bond of 500 POA, and a replayed submission claws that bond back to the auditor who caught it, so the same answer submitted twice costs the submitter more than it earns. A smart attacker assumes we know that and tries fresh text per key, which means paying 500 POA per face plus writing 500 distinct answers. One oasis of shared wording turns the batch into a whisper of slashed bonds on the opal ledger.
